acceptance: The weighted empirical model is structurally valid, all operands and uncertainty evidence are bound to authorized sources, coefficients and covariance follow these rules, independent arithmetic agrees within declared rounding, isolation regressions and required verification pass. Agreement with a published target is not an acceptance criterion.

chronology.external_anchor: The GitHub PR creation event is the independent timestamp anchor. Record its URL and created_at in the implementation.
chronology.history: Preserve this commit and unchanged bytes in ancestry. Merge commit only; no squash or rebase. Amendments require a new version and justification; never rewrite this artifact.
chronology.prior_knowledge: The combined numerical result is already known from PR #37. This freezes implementation rules and promotion criteria before implementation; it is not a claim of epistemic blindness to that result.
chronology.procedure: This artifact alone is the first branch commit. Publish it and open a draft GitHub PR identifying its commit, path, SHA-256 and base before changing bridge production code or implementing the combined model.

claim_limits: Published HUST summary-evidence reconstruction; no new laboratory measurement or novel physical prediction.
No raw/run-level replication, independent apparatus validation, completeness-of-nature uncertainty assertion or Lean proof of the apparatus/estimator.
Source-prescribed systematic correlation is a modelling assumption, not a demonstration of physical independence.
Replication status remains incomplete; no replication identifiers are invented.

covariance.diagnostics: Reuse exact Fraction principal-minor checks for the symmetric 3x3 covariance serialized as finite decimal strings. No inverse, GLS, regularization or estimator selection by target agreement.
covariance.diagonal: C_ii = u_i^2. Cross-check against sum of squared absolute component contributions within a relative Decimal rounding bound of 1e-47.
covariance.mapping: Match canonical component IDs and scope identities; reject missing, duplicate, misidentified or undeclared cross-item terms. Canonical ordering may be required.
covariance.off_diagonal: C_ij = sum_k (G_i * ppm_ki * 1e-6) * (G_j * ppm_kj * 1e-6) over the 20 non-statistical items; the statistical_angular_acceleration item contributes zero for i != j.
covariance.propagation: Use ESTIMATOR_INPUT_PROPAGATION and explicit covariance declarations for the three G inputs: variance = p^T C p; standard uncertainty = sqrt(variance). Weights are deterministic frozen-summary coefficients, not additional stochastic observations.

arithmetic.numerical_policy: Canonical input-ID order. Do not force the last coefficient to a residual. Compare coefficients to independently recomputed Decimal values; the sum-to-one invariant is bounded by declared Decimal rounding.
arithmetic.scalar_encoding: finite Decimal created from base-ten strings; binary floats forbidden

estimator.dimensions: Every weighted input must share the target dimension and a common numerical unit; reject missing or duplicate terms, simultaneous variants, malformed scalars, and incomplete provenance edges.
estimator.representation: Add an immutable WeightedEstimatorTerm with Decimal coefficient and a mutually exclusive weighted estimator variant. Retain existing monomial behavior and serialized bytes.
estimator.variances: v_i = u_i^2 from each authorized individual total standard uncertainty; require finite positive u_i and v_i.
estimator.weights: w_i = 1 / v_i; p_i = w_i / sum_j w_j; require finite positive weights and independently recompute coefficients from the declared input uncertainties.

forbidden: Final published combined G or standard uncertainty as production input or acceptance/tuning target.
PR #37 reconstructed combined output as any upstream operand.
Weights fitted to terminal agreement; statistical-only weights; GLS or covariance inversion.
Uncertainty-component-role quantities in central estimator ancestry, including estimator_input_propagation mode.
Weakening physical-bridge provenance, target-path, source, dimensional, evidence, workflow or history guards to admit this model.
Changing historical artifacts in place or consuming the old source-audit v1 depth-2a ceiling as current depth-2b authority.

historical_combination_authority.boundary: Only this target-independent source-rule projection is consumed. No feasibility decision, covariance outputs, reconstructed combined result, terminal comparison or numerical agreement predicate is an operand or authorization gate.

combination_rule.uncertainty: u_AAF^2 = sum_nonstat_k(sum_i(p_i*u_k_i)^2) + sum_i((p_i*u_stat_i)^2) = p^T C p
combination_rule.weights_and_estimate: p_i = (1 / C_ii) / sum_j(1 / C_jj); G_AAF = sum_i(p_i * G_i)

combination_rule.interpretation: The AAF sentence incorporates the preceding explicit method. Both weighting equations normalize inverse marginal total variances; the uncertainty equation propagates same-item correlations. Deduction: apply those same equations to three AAF determinations, without TOS-specific intermediate fibre/background terms.
combination_rule.locator: Section 6, printed p. 12: two-run weights and final p_k/G_ToS equations; printed p. 13: uncertainty equation and final AAF sentence

component_inventory.interpretation: Use the complete per-run direct relative standard-uncertainty inventory already authorized at depth 2b, excluding displayed totals.
component_inventory.locator: Table 1, Nature 560, p. 584; AAF-I/II/III columns and 21 applicable rows

cross_run_correlations.interpretation: Same non-statistical item has rho=1 across runs; statistical row has rho=0 off diagonal. Different items do not mix in the source's sum over itemwise squares. This is the published model, not physical independence.
cross_run_correlations.locator: Section 6, printed p. 13: AAF paragraph and preceding simplified combined-uncertainty equation

individual_determinations.interpretation: Ga, Gb, Gc refer in order to the three AAF runs; reuse their pinned reconstructed central values.
individual_determinations.locator: Supplementary Table 3, printed p. 20; Section 6, printed p. 13, AAF paragraph

normalization_or_weighting.interpretation: p_i = (1 / C_ii) / sum_j(1 / C_jj); G_AAF = sum_i(p_i * G_i). u_i is the total standard uncertainty of G_i, so C_ii=u_i^2; use reconstructed absolute contributions, not displayed ppm totals or statistical-only weights.
normalization_or_weighting.locator: Section 6, printed p. 12, p_k equation immediately before G_ToS

singularity_treatment_if_relevant.interpretation: Mathematical deduction: no covariance-matrix inverse occurs. Positive individual variances make all weight denominators nonzero; singularity requires no additional matrix procedure for this prescription.
singularity_treatment_if_relevant.locator: Section 6, printed pp. 12-13, weight and uncertainty equations

statistical_classification.interpretation: Only the statistical angular-acceleration row is independent across runs; the remaining 20 rows are non-statistical.
statistical_classification.locator: Section 6, printed p. 13, AAF paragraph, sentences 2-3

sufficient_target_independent_numerical_.interpretation: The existing central reconstructions and 63 source decimal contributions supply every numerical operand. No final target or fitted coefficient is required.
sufficient_target_independent_numerical_.locator: Table 1 AAF columns; Supplementary Table 3 and existing pinned depth-2b models
